name: Local Commander
tagline: Work on approved projects on your Windows computers: read files and Git, run the checks you approve.
description:
Local Commander connects Cline and other MCP clients to Windows 11 computers you own. Your AI can read approved project files and Git state, run the checks and commands you authorize, and check local services. Your workspace at localcmd.app shows which computer ran each request and how it ended.

Once you approve a computer and connect your AI, it can do what your Windows account can do; you can limit it to folders, block commands or switch it off at any time. Requires a Local Commander account and the agent paired on the Windows PC (`npx local-commander-agent@latest`). Sign-in uses OAuth 2.0 in the browser.

Free: unlimited runs on up to 5 computers. Team pack: 10 more computers for $15 a month.
